description: Read only: observe sanitized native main catalog cache identity for compiler adoption and retention reconciliation; never compile, apply, accept or delete a catalog

expectations.description: Exact hostname, certname and configured Puppet server. Native Linux or Darwin Ruby with root escalation required; Cygwin/Windows unsupported. Linux emits schema 1; Darwin emits schema 2 with its exact native boot-session UUID. Missing, unsafe, changing or non-main caches refuse; a present null code_id is legacy mutable content, not unknown or an immutable release.
